each measured-versus-estimated gap updates the tank's dated efficiency factor
coupon-calibrated deposition rates re-parameterize the next runs' time estimates
an escalation returns to intake and rewrites the spec - a new floor, a waiver, or a refusal
gold-cost pressure pushes delivery toward the floor while the spec demands margin at the worst point
edges.resolution_rule: the spec floor at the measured worst point always wins; trimming is legitimate only above a first-article-verified floor, and a spec that is uneconomic is renegotiated at intake, never quietly underdelivered

edges.why_related: one current setting serves both zones: current low enough to spare the edges starves the recesses, current high enough to feed the recesses burns the edges
edges.resolution_rule: set current for the starved zone's floor and protect the hot zones with shields, robbers or repositioning; if no arrangement satisfies both, the geometry escalates rather than either zone being sacrificed silently

edges.why_related: throughput pressure invites setups the manual does not sanction - paralleled outputs, oversized loads, improvised wiring
edges.resolution_rule: manufacturer instructions and the electrician hand-off line always win; the load is split, rescheduled or refused, and no deadline reclassifies mains-side or off-manual work as bench work

edges.why_related: the arithmetic can declare a load done while the measurement says thin, and the schedule sides with the arithmetic
edges.resolution_rule: measurement beats estimate every time they disagree: the load returns to the tank or the batch holds, and the estimate's inputs are recalibrated - the estimate is never defended against the deposit

edges.why_related: both are measurement method classes closing the same loop: the coupon integrates average deposition over known area while XRF reads points on real work - complementary honesty about the same run

conflict_axes.name: throughput_speed_vs_deposit_quality
conflict_axes.description: Higher current density shortens runs and the schedule always wants it, but the window's top edge is where burn, stress and efficiency collapse live.
poles: push density up to move the queue
hold mid-window for a clean deposit
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: time is bought with agitation, equipment and scheduling, never by exceeding the TDS window; the burn watch on mapped hot features arbitrates in-run

conflict_axes.name: estimate_arithmetic_vs_measured_truth
conflict_axes.description: Faraday arithmetic produces confident numbers from uncertain inputs; the deposit is the only witness that cannot be wrong.
poles: trust the computed thickness and ship
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the estimate schedules, the measurement releases: first article gates every batch and every disagreement recalibrates the estimator

conflict_axes.name: edge_burn_vs_recess_starvation
conflict_axes.description: On one piece at one setting, the hot features and the starved zones make opposite demands on the same dial.
poles: protect the edges with low current
feed the recesses with high current
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: plate for the recess floor, defend the edges with shields, robbers and distance, and escalate the geometry when no arrangement serves both

conflict_axes.name: gold_cost_vs_spec_floor_margin
conflict_axes.description: Every micron above floor across a load is bought metal; every micron below it is a rework that spends double.
poles: trim delivery toward the floor to save gold
carry margin so no point ever misses
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: trim only above a first-article-measured worst-point floor, tightening batch by batch as the log earns trust - undershoot is always the dearer error

conflict_axes.name: handbook_orientation_vs_tds_authority
conflict_axes.description: Handbook-class ranges and old habits are fluent and available; the specific product's TDS and this tank's log are the only numbers that govern.
poles: run only on TDS windows refined by the log
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: handbook classes orient and teach; the TDS plus dated log baselines decide - any run sheet number must cite one of those two

conflict_axes.name: rigging_ingenuity_vs_equipment_limits
conflict_axes.description: Auxiliary anodes, robbers and clever wiring solve real distribution problems, and the same ingenuity drifts toward setups no manual sanctions.
poles: build the rig the geometry needs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: ingenuity lives inside the equipment class: sanctioned materials, insulated leads, current sharing per the manual - and what cannot be rigged inside those limits escalates

conflict_axes.name: batch_average_vs_worst_point
conflict_axes.description: Averages and convenient flats pass batches quickly; specs are honest only at the mapped worst point of the worst piece.
poles: judge every job at its mapped worst point
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the spec names its worst point and the first article measures there; averages inform economics, never release

conflict_axes.name: deadline_pressure_vs_verification_gate
conflict_axes.description: The first-article hold and the morning meter check are exactly the disciplines a rushed day argues are skippable.
poles: run the batch straight through and check later
hold at every verification gate regardless of schedule
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the gates exist because their failures replicate across batches; safety and verification beat throughput and deadline wherever they meet

conflict_axes.name: taking_the_job_vs_escalating_the_geometry
conflict_axes.description: An ornate piece is revenue and a compliment to the shop's skill, and sometimes it is also undeliverable as specified.
poles: accept and do one's best quietly
escalate to an honest respec, waiver or refusal
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the map and the tried-mitigations record decide, not pride: a documented customer decision beats a quiet shortfall on every axis that matters

edge_cases.description: A filigree pendant reads comfortably on-spec at its flat back while the recessed scrollwork carries a fraction of the floor
edge_cases.trigger: measurement points sit on convenient flats instead of mapped worst zones
edge_cases.mitigation: the spec names the worst zone as a measurement point and the first article is read there; a floor the recess cannot reach is disclosed or escalated, not averaged away

edge_cases.description: A mixed-size ring batch is estimated as ring count times one nominal area, and the small sizes burn while the large ones run thin
edge_cases.trigger: per-piece nominal area applied to a load whose sizes vary widely
edge_cases.mitigation: estimate area from actual sizes or weight-and-gauge, or split the batch into size groups with their own settings

edge_cases.description: The panel ammeter holds the set current all run, but one rack arm's corroded hook passed almost nothing - its pieces come out flash-thin and the rest overplated
edge_cases.trigger: a high-resistance contact inside a constant-current circuit redistributes current invisibly
edge_cases.mitigation: log entry and mid-run voltage against the job class's typical band and stop on excursion; contact repair itself belongs to fixturing, detection belongs here

edge_cases.description: A soft-gold near-quantitative efficiency habit is applied to an acid hard gold tank and the batch delivers roughly half the specified thickness
edge_cases.trigger: an efficiency factor carried across bath families
edge_cases.mitigation: efficiency factors are labeled by bath family and tank, and a bath-family change resets the factor to the TDS class band pending coupon calibration

edge_cases.description: A bath several months into service deposits noticeably less per ampere-minute than at make-up, and runs sized by the old factor come out thin
edge_cases.trigger: efficiency drift with bath age and accumulated service
edge_cases.mitigation: first-article verification every batch plus reconciliation of ledger versus measurement, so drift shows as a trend and refreshes the factor before it costs a batch

edge_cases.description: Prong tips on claw settings turn matte then brown at a current the shanks tolerate happily
edge_cases.trigger: sharp features exceed limiting current density while the load average sits mid-window
edge_cases.mitigation: map claw tips as hot features in advance, fit a robber loop or shield, and watch the hottest feature at first inspection rather than the average surface

edge_cases.description: A hollow bead the customer expects gilded inside receives nearly nothing internally because no external anode's field enters the cavity
edge_cases.trigger: internal surfaces specified on a geometry only an internal anode class could serve
edge_cases.mitigation: either an internal anode class the shop actually has delivers the cavity, or the job escalates to an exterior-only respec or waiver before plating starts

edge_cases.description: The supply was left in constant-voltage mode from a stripping task, and current climbs as the bath warms while the operator watches thickness math built on the starting amps
edge_cases.trigger: wrong regulation mode carried over between tasks
edge_cases.mitigation: mode selection is on the pre-entry setup record, and the ledger logs the actual current at checks rather than assuming the dial

edge_cases.description: XRF against the wrong stack model reads a fluent, wrong thickness on gold over nickel over brass and the batch passes on paper
edge_cases.trigger: instrument calibration mismatched to the actual layer stack or base metal
edge_cases.mitigation: calibration is chosen from the job's stack spec, and a coupon weight-gain cross-check catches a confidently wrong instrument setup

edge_cases.description: During a rushed transfer the rack hangs in the gold for several seconds before the current goes on, and the pieces later peel from an invisible immersion film
edge_cases.trigger: dead entry at any gold tank under transfer haste
edge_cases.mitigation: the live-entry ritual is fixed and ticked per entry; a suspected dead entry backs out immediately per the stack's strip or re-activate rules instead of plating over it

edge_cases.description: A delicate enameled antique cannot be clipped anywhere without marking it, and the bench is tempted to clamp harder and buff later
edge_cases.trigger: no contact arrangement exists that both carries current and leaves the piece undamaged
edge_cases.mitigation: the piece escalates to intake for a documented decision - visible-contact waiver, alternative process discussion, or refusal; force is never the answer on a customer piece

edge_cases.description: A borrowed high-ripple supply delivers the set average current but the deposit comes out dull and streaky against the same settings' history
edge_cases.trigger: output ripple outside the class the chemistry tolerates, at a correct-looking average current
edge_cases.mitigation: supplies are used within their documented output class per the TDS's expectations, and an unexplained quality shift after a hardware swap points first at the swap

workflow.description: Write microns, wear class, measurement points and compliance flags before anything is racked
workflow.artifact: job spec sheet with named worst-point and marking/nickel-release flags
workflow.gate: microns, wear class, measurement points and flags all present; no unspecified 'gold plate it' proceeds

workflow.description: Read the product TDS window and the shop log baselines that apply to this tank and job class
workflow.artifact: window sheet citing TDS and dated log baselines
workflow.gate: every number on the run sheet cites TDS or log; habit and handbook figures appear nowhere as settings

workflow.description: Decompose, weigh or compare to reference pieces; count robbers and exposed rack; state the error band
workflow.artifact: area estimate with method and error band
workflow.gate: method named, both-sides and robber corrections applied, band stated

workflow.action: Choose current density and compute amps
workflow.description: Position inside the TDS window for today's agitation, load certainty and geometry, then convert to amps
workflow.artifact: amp setting derived as density times area with position-in-window rationale
workflow.gate: density inside the window, positioned with a stated reason, amps recomputed for this load

workflow.action: Map current distribution and plan zone controls
workflow.description: Mark hot features and starved zones on the actual pieces, name the worst point, plan shields, robbers or auxiliary anodes - or trigger escalation
workflow.artifact: marked distribution map with mitigation plan or escalation finding
workflow.gate: worst point named and covered by a measurement point; any cannot-deliver finding escalated before racking

workflow.description: Run the Faraday arithmetic with the dated efficiency factor and state the expected band
workflow.artifact: time and ampere-minute plan labeled unverified
workflow.gate: area, density, dated factor and band all shown; the estimate is marked estimate

workflow.action: Set up and verify the rectifier
workflow.description: Constant-current mode, polarity at the bar, meter cross-check and delivered-current confirmation per the manual
workflow.gate: mode, polarity, meter and delivered-current checks all pass before the first entry

workflow.description: Current set and confirmed flowing, continuity checked, ammeter response observed as the work immerses
workflow.artifact: ticked entry checklist per gold-tank entry
workflow.gate: no immersion without confirmed current; a suspected dead entry backs out

workflow.description: Log voltage at entry and checks against the job class's typical band; inspect mapped hot features early
workflow.artifact: in-run log lines with voltage and burn-watch notes
workflow.gate: any voltage excursion or early burn triggers stop-and-look, not schedule defense

workflow.description: Record current, times and interruptions during the run and close the line at withdrawal
workflow.artifact: completed ledger line for the load
workflow.gate: ledger written during the run with interruptions logged at zero current

workflow.description: Measure the mapped worst point and high-wear points against a stack-matched calibration before the batch continues
workflow.gate: floor met at the worst point or the batch holds; no remainder plates against an unverified first article

workflow.description: Reconcile ledger versus measurement, update the efficiency factor from coupon or first-article evidence, and set the next batch's trim above the verified floor
workflow.artifact: reconciliation note and updated factor in the shop log
workflow.gate: factor updates cite their evidence; any trim preserves the measured worst-point floor

dominance_rules.rule: Measured thickness beats any Faraday estimate
dominance_rules.rationale: the deposit is the only witness that cannot be wrong; the arithmetic's inputs are all estimates
dominance_rules.trigger: estimate and measurement disagree on whether a load is done
dominance_rules.action: hold or return the load per the measurement and recalibrate the estimator's inputs; never defend the estimate

dominance_rules.rule: The TDS window plus the shop log beat handbook figures and habit
dominance_rules.rationale: the specific commercial product and this tank's evidence are the only governing sources for numbers
dominance_rules.action: cite TDS or a dated log baseline on the run sheet; a setting citing neither does not run

dominance_rules.rationale: mains, heaters and conductive liquids form the room's lethal combination and improvisation is its trigger
dominance_rules.trigger: a load or schedule tempts off-manual wiring, paralleling or capacity pushes
dominance_rules.action: split the load, reschedule or refuse; refer mains-side work to a qualified electrician

dominance_rules.rule: The worst-point floor beats the batch average
dominance_rules.rationale: specs are worn at their thinnest point; averages hide exactly the zones that fail first
dominance_rules.trigger: release is argued from average or convenient-flat readings
dominance_rules.action: release only on the mapped worst point meeting floor; averages inform economics, never release

dominance_rules.rule: Escalation beats forcing an undeliverable piece
dominance_rules.rationale: no job is worth damaging a customer piece or shipping a quiet shortfall on it
dominance_rules.trigger: the map or the contact situation shows spec cannot be delivered without damage or shortfall
dominance_rules.action: escalate to intake with the mitigation record for a respec, waiver, referral or refusal

dominance_rules.rule: The quality window beats the deadline at the current dial
dominance_rules.rationale: burn, stress and efficiency collapse cost more than the minutes the window's top edge saves
dominance_rules.trigger: schedule pressure argues for density above the window or above today's agitation
dominance_rules.action: buy time with agitation, scheduling or a second run; the window holds

dominance_rules.rule: The nickel-release compliance flag survives every hand-off
dominance_rules.rationale: a nickel underplate on skin-contact goods is a regulated compliance class regardless of which KB touches the job
dominance_rules.trigger: a job whose stack contains nickel passes through electrical planning
dominance_rules.action: carry the flag on the spec and forward it to verification and marking with the verify-jurisdiction note intact

dominance_rules.rule: The first-article gate beats batch momentum
dominance_rules.rationale: an unverified error replicates across every piece that plates behind it
dominance_rules.trigger: the remainder of a batch is queued before the first article is measured
dominance_rules.action: the batch holds until the worst-point reading passes; momentum is not evidence

dominance_rules.rationale: the immersion film a dead entry creates is invisible at release and fails in the customer's hands
dominance_rules.trigger: a rushed transfer tempts hanging work before current is on
dominance_rules.action: current confirmed first, every entry, every tank; a suspected dead entry backs out immediately

dominance_rules.rationale: aerosolized cyanide solution is an exposure route; no distribution problem justifies creating one
dominance_rules.trigger: someone proposes air-sparging a cyanide-bearing gold bath to raise the limiting current
dominance_rules.action: use mechanical or pumped agitation per the TDS and route any upgrade through the safety-compliance obligation classes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Estimate area - robbers and exposed rack included - before choosing any current
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a load starved or burned at amps computed from the wrong area, and the strip-and-replate that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify rectifier mode, polarity and metering before the first entry of the day and after any hardware change
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a whole day of silently mis-metered runs poisoning batches, ledger and shop log at once

anti_rework_rules.rule: Map distribution and fit shields, robbers or auxiliary anodes before the run, not after the first burn
anti_rework_rules.prevents: burned tips and starved recesses discovered mid-batch, each costing a strip or a re-run

anti_rework_rules.rule: Use the bath-family-correct, dated efficiency factor before computing any run time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: half-thickness batches from a soft-gold habit applied to a low-efficiency tank

anti_rework_rules.rule: Measure the first article before any further piece of the batch plates
anti_rework_rules.prevents: one correctable error replicated across the entire batch

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm current is flowing before every gold-tank immersion
anti_rework_rules.prevents: immersion films that pass release and peel in the customer's hands weeks later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Recompute amps whenever the load, a robber or an auxiliary anode changes
anti_rework_rules.prevents: yesterday's amps burning today's smaller load after one piece was pulled

anti_rework_rules.rule: Re-derate current for the agitation actually running before the next entry
anti_rework_rules.prevents: burn at previously clean settings after a stirrer slows or a tank fills

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the spec floor and its worst measurement point before quoting or racking
anti_rework_rules.prevents: handover disputes and re-plates on jobs judged at points nobody agreed to

iteration_protocol.trigger: the first article misses the estimate's band
iteration_protocol.action: hold the batch, reconcile ledger versus measurement, recalibrate the efficiency factor or area estimate, and re-plan before releasing anything

iteration_protocol.trigger: burn recurs at settings that previously ran clean
iteration_protocol.action: audit agitation state, re-check the area estimate and robber count, and re-map hot features before touching the window position

iteration_protocol.trigger: a TDS revision arrives or the bath product changes
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the window sheet, reset the efficiency factor to the new class band pending coupon calibration, and retire stale log baselines

iteration_protocol.trigger: cell voltage trends outside the job class's typical band
iteration_protocol.action: stop and look: re-verify metering, inspect anode and contact circuit, and log the confirmed cause against the voltage signature

iteration_protocol.trigger: a recess misses floor while flats pass
iteration_protocol.action: escalate the mitigation ladder: reposition, fit the applicable auxiliary anode class, or trigger the geometry escalation with the record of what was tried

iteration_protocol.trigger: enough reconciled runs accumulate on one tank and job class
iteration_protocol.action: tighten the shop's in-window operating bands and trim margins from evidence, updating the log baselines the next runs cite

iteration_protocol.trigger: a marking or nickel-release rule changes in a selling jurisdiction
iteration_protocol.action: re-flag the affected spec classes and re-verify which jobs' compliance flags need new wording before their next run

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because everything else consumes them: the written spec defines what delivery means, the TDS-and-log authority defines where numbers may come from, and the electrical safety boundary defines what may be touched at all; area then feeds density, density and efficiency feed the Faraday estimate, and the equipment nodes make the delivered current real and provable; the geometry nodes adapt the plan to actual jewelry shapes before execution; live entry and voltage watch govern the run itself; and the verification nodes close every loop last because measurement is the only step that converts all upstream estimates into delivered, logged, trimmable fact.
